data.title: 时崎狂三 · 月下钟楼
data.description: 【时崎狂三 · 月下钟楼】巨大的金色时钟表盘在绯红满月下缓缓逆转，狂三立于高耸入云的哥特钟楼之巅。黑色哥特萝莉蓬蓬裙随夜风猎猎作响，左眼的金色时钟刻盘幽光流转，红唇勾起妖异而优雅的弧度——「啊啦啊啦，今夜的月色可真是诱人呢。这位先生，准备好将您的一切……献给刻刻帝了吗？」
data.action: 立于钟楼顶端，身后金色时钟表盘旋转
data.camera: full-body shot, dramatic low angle, clock face behind the figure
data.promptProse: Kurumi stands on the broad crown of a gothic clock tower, head tilted in an enigmatic smile as night wind stirs her black-and-crimson ruffles and twintails. The low full-body view includes her feet on the ledge beneath the rotating golden clock face and crimson moon. Golden dial light illuminates her sleeves and clock-patterned left eye; cool moonlight outlines the tower's masonry against the sky.
